question: What is MWG franchise and how does it work?
answer: Mr. White Gloves Franchise is a doorstep car wash business opportunity. You invest once, MWG provides the complete car wash kit, employee hiring support, business setup guidance, and 24x7 marketing support. You run the business in your city and earn profits from every wash booking and monthly subscription.

question: How much does MWG franchise cost? What is the franchise price?
answer: MWG Franchise investment is ₹1,90,000 + GST. This is a one-time investment to start your own doorstep car wash business. It is the most affordable auto-sector franchise for new entrepreneurs, starting under ₹2 lakhs.

question: What is the ROI and how much profit can I earn from franchise?
answer: MWG franchise gives ROI in less than 6 months. Month 1 profit: ₹45,000. Months 2-6 profit: ₹54,000/month. From Month 7 with 2 service partners doing 10 washes/day: Total Revenue ₹1,95,000 and Profit ₹1,05,000/month. Real success: Mr. Ayush Dangi, Haridwar franchise owner earned ₹1 lakh+ monthly profit within 6 months.

question: What is included in the MWG franchise kit? What equipment do I get?
answer: MWG Franchise Kit includes: Pressure Washer (1 set), Vacuum Cleaner (1 set), Polish Machine (1 set), Foam Cannon (1 set), Bag (1 set), Chemicals (100 sets), Detailing Kit (1 set), Tire Inflator (1 set), T-Shirts (5 sets), Customized Bucket (1 set), Microfibre Cloths (15 sets), Power Backup (1 set). It is a complete self-powered doorstep car wash kit.

question: What support does MWG provide to franchise partners?
answer: MWG provides 4 types of support: (1) MWG Kit - complete self-powered doorstep car wash equipment. (2) Employee Hiring and Training support - MWG manages hiring via job portals and provides on-field training. (3) Business Establishment - face to face setup guidance until successful launch. (4) 24x7 Marketing Support - dedicated team providing 2 to 10 car wash leads daily.

question: Do I need an office space for MWG franchise?
answer: No office space is required. The MWG franchise is fully mobile. The car wash kits can be stored at your home or any convenient location. Our trained staff travels to customer locations for every wash booking.

question: Do I need to find customers or bring orders myself for franchise?
answer: No. MWG provides 24x7 online marketing support ensuring daily orders. You receive approximately 2 to 10 car wash leads every day. You also get offline marketing materials and WhatsApp remarketing campaigns. You do not need to find customers independently.

question: What is the step by step process to get MWG franchise? How to apply?
answer: Franchise onboarding steps: (1) Initial discussion - answer business queries and city demand analysis. (2) Pay ₹5,000 token amount to lock your city. (3) Complete full payment of ₹1,90,000 within 15 days. (4) Sign official agreement papers. (5) MWG team visits your city - provides kit, trains employees, sets up business, and launches offline and online marketing campaigns.

question: What is the revenue projection for MWG franchise?
answer: Revenue projection: Month 1 - 5 services/day, 130/month, Revenue ₹65,000, Profit ₹45,000. Months 2-6 - Revenue ₹1,04,000 (including ₹39,000 subscription from 30 cars), Profit ₹54,000. Month 7+ with 2 partners - 10 services/day, Revenue ₹1,95,000 (including ₹65,000 subscription from 50 cars), Profit ₹1,05,000.

answer: Mr. White Gloves manages employee hiring through online job portals. On-field training is provided by MWG team during their visit to your city. Ready-made training videos are also available online for your staff anytime.
